facts.function: detect vehicles and axles by inductance for traffic counting

gri_path: GRI 1: 8543 electrical apparatus with individual functions not elsewhere specified; sensors/transducers fall at 8543.70.45 per CBP

rejected_alternatives.reason: other measuring/checking instruments; electrical sensor treated as chapter 85 transducer

missing_facts: whether loops are plain wire (8544) or include detector electronics
classification.rationale: Inductive loops and axle sensors are electrical transducers sending signals on detection; N362482 classes an axle sensor as a transducer at 8543.70.4500. Low confidence: plain loop wire or measuring instruments of 9031 are arguable.
